indication_area: Thrombocytopenia in adult patients with chronic liver disease scheduled to undergo a procedure
revenue_scope: Japan domestic prescription-drug sales of Mulpleta by Shionogi, fiscal year April-March; period is the calendar year in which the fiscal year begins
annual_basis: Shionogi's fiscal years 2016-2023 (April-March) from the 'Sales of Prescription Drugs in Japan' table of each year's own results presentation or supplement, where Mulpleta is itemised in Japan. Each period is relabelled as the year in which the April-March fiscal year ends (FY2016 = April 2016-March 2017 is period 2017).

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 210923 NDA APPROVAL ... Mulpleta (lusutrombopag) tablets, 3 mg ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter

launch_evidence.quote: S-888711 (lusutrombopag) [Japan: Mulpleta] Thrombopoetin (TPO) receptor agonist (oral) Thrombocytopenia associated with chronic liver disease Japan: Approval (Sep. 2015)

series_start_reason: FY2016 is the first fiscal year in which a Mulpleta figure was found; Mulpleta was approved in Japan in September 2015 (FY2015) and the FY2015 supplement (sup16_05.pdf) and presentation (e_p160511.pdf) were searched and print no Mulpleta sales figure.
series_end_reason: The FY2023 supplement (FY2023.4Q_Supplement.pdf) prints '-' as the FY2024 forecast for Mulpleta and states 'Others in prescription drugs for FY2024 include revenue from MULPLETA and PIRESPA'; the FY2024 results presentation (E_FY2024_financial results_f1.pdf) has no Mulpleta line. The last fiscal year with a figure is FY2023 (period 2023, April 2023-March 2024); series_end_quarter is null because the series is annual.
notes: Japan-only series in billions of yen. Values are 0.1-0.2 B yen (100-200 million yen) a year and are printed to one decimal place from FY2020, so rounding is a large share of each value (two decimals are printed for FY2018 and FY2019). FY2017 is 0.2 in its own supplement and 0.16 in the FY2018 presentation's prior-year column. A separate U.S. Mulpleta line exists but is not used: e_p200511.pdf p11 ('Sales by Segment', B yen) prints 'Mulpleta 1.0 1.0 0.54 54.3 0.08* -* 0.5' on the row directly beneath 'Shionogi Inc.' (columns FY2019 forecast, revised forecast, FY2019 results, achievement %, FY2018 results, changes), i.e. U.S. FY2019 0.54 and FY2018 0.08, with the footnote '* The full-scale promotion was initiated in Dec. 2018'; e_p190509.pdf p15 prints 'Mulpleta 1.0 0.25 0.08' for FY2018. That line covers only FY2018-FY2019 and the Q1 FY2020 presentation says 'US: Decrease in Mulpleta sales' without a figure, so the Japan series is kept as the longer consistent span. The Japan series is 0.1-0.2 B yen, so rounding to one decimal can be up to about 50 percent of a value. Mulpleta is also sold in China by Eddingpharm (partner), with no sales figure found.

no_quarterly_series.source_quote: Shionogi FY2022 supplement, 9-1 quarterly trend for FY2021 and FY2022 (revenue by segment), B yen, actual and year-on-year change % for 1Q-4Q | MULPLETA 0.0 (12.4) 0.0 (3.0) 0.0 (23.2) 0.0 (29.1)
no_quarterly_series.details: Shionogi's quarterly-trend tables print Mulpleta for each quarter as 0.0 billion yen (to one decimal), i.e. below the precision of the table, so no quarterly value can be read; the annual figures are used instead.

search_log: Scanned ~130 of the 359 English documents linked from shionogi.com's presentation-materials and financial-results-supplement pages for Mulpleta lines, then opened each fiscal year's Q4 presentation or supplement directly (FY2016-FY2023 under /content/dam/shionogi/global/investors/pdf/ and /ir-library/presentation/).
Mulpleta appears under 'Sales of Prescription Drugs in Japan' (or 'Revenue of Prescription Drugs in Japan') in B yen; no Japan or worldwide quarterly figure above 0.0/0.1 is printed.
FY2015 Q4 documents (sup16_05.pdf, e_p160511.pdf) searched: no Mulpleta figure.
Other issuers: Eddingpharm (China licensee) was not searched; no U.S. or worldwide Mulpleta net sales document was located.

Re-read e_p200511.pdf p11 with pdfplumber: 'Sales by Segment' lists 'Shionogi Inc.' and then 'Mulpleta' (0.54 FY2019, 0.08 FY2018), so the earlier unidentified line is the U.S. (Shionogi Inc.) line; its span is FY2018-FY2019 only, so it was not used for the series.
